## SnapSort 1.3.0 — Every screenshot, filed

**New: knows the app even when the file name doesn't.** Some phones don't write the app into a screenshot's name. Turn on Usage access once and SnapSort looks up the app that was open at the exact moment you took each screenshot — no guessing, and nothing leaves your phone. New screenshots keep getting filed in the background.

- Anything older than Android's usage history? Select it and tap **Set app**. Your choice always wins.
- Tap details on any screenshot to see how SnapSort knows its app.

**New: Swipe to clean.** Go through your screenshots one card at a time: left to delete, right to keep, up to favorite, with undo. Everything you mark is deleted together at the end, after a summary. Start it from Clean up, or from any app's page.

**Fixed**
- Installs on every Android phone, including 32-bit ones like the Samsung Galaxy A10.
- Deleting works on Android 10: SnapSort asks for storage access the first time, and tells you if a delete didn't go through.

Updating? Just install over the old version — your albums and favorites stay.
